mapper.insert: insert into schedule( schedule_no, course_no, schedule_open, schedule_close, schedule_week, schedule_start, schedule_end, classroom_no ) values( #{scheduleNo}, #{courseNo}, #{scheduleOpen}, #{scheduleClose}, #{scheduleWeek}, #{scheduleStart}, #{scheduleEnd}, #{classroomNo} )
mapper.select: select s.schedule_no, s.course_no, s.classroom_no, s.schedule_week, s.schedule_start, s.schedule_end, s.schedule_open, s.schedule_close from schedule s join course c on s.course_no = c.course_no where c.course_status = '진행중' and s.schedule_open is not null and (s.schedule_close is null or s.schedule_close >= CURRENT_DATE) order by s.schedule_no asc

SELECT s.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, s.course_no AS courseNo, s.schedule_week AS scheduleWeek, s.schedule_start AS scheduleStart, s.schedule_end AS scheduleEnd, s.schedule_open AS scheduleOpen, s.schedule_close AS scheduleClose, s.classroom_no AS classroomNo FROM schedule s JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no WHERE s.schedule_week = #{todayKorean} AND c.course_status = '진행중'
AND s.schedule_open IS NOT NULL AND s.schedule_open <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND (s.schedule_close IS NULL OR s.schedule_close >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ORDER BY s.schedule_start ASC

select s.schedule_no, s.course_no, c.course_title,
c.employee_no, a.account_name as employee_name,
s.classroom_no, cr.classroom_name,
s.schedule_week, s.schedule_start, s.schedule_end,
s.schedule_open, s.schedule_close
from schedule s
join course c on s.course_no = c.course_no
join employee e on c.employee_no = e.employee_no
join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no
join classroom cr on s.classroom_no = cr.classroom_no
where c.course_status not in ('종료', '폐강')
and ( s.schedule_open is null or s.schedule_open <= #{weekEnd} )
and ( s.schedule_close is null or s.schedule_close >= #{weekStart} )
order by case s.schedule_week when '월' then 1 when '화' then 2 when '수' then 3 when '목' then 4 when '금' then 5 when '토' then 6 when '일' then 7 end, s.schedule_start asc

SELECT s.schedule_no, s.schedule_week, s.schedule_start, s.schedule_end, s.schedule_open, s.schedule_close FROM schedule s JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no WHERE c.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and c.course_status in ('진행중', '모집중')
